t: Fortress Trade 4 inch medium pile roller sleeves are engineered for efficient and smooth application of emulsion paints. These durable roller sleeves are ideal for professional decorators and DIY enthusiasts tackling walls and ceilings in various domestic and commercial environments. The advanced microfibre mix ensures excellent paint loading and consistent release, delivering superior coverage with minimal splatter. Featuring closed fibres for a uniform, even texture and thermobonded fabric for minimal lint loss, these sleeves provide a clean and professional finish every time.
b: Closed Fibres for Smooth Even Texture
Thermobonded Fabric Delivers Minimal Lint Loss
